mapper.select:
SELECT branch.branchid, branch.branchname, member.memberno, member.memberid, member.type, member.membername, member.schoolcode, member.schoolname, member.grade, member.gender, member.contact, member.email, member.os, member.pushtoken, member.marketing, member.push, DATE_FORMAT(member.regdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') regdate FROM ttok.member member, ttok.branch branch
AND member.branchid = branch.branchid AND member.memberid = #{memberid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttok.member ( branchid, memberid, memberpw, type, membername, schoolcode, schoolname, grade, gender, contact, email, marketing, push, regdate ) VALUES ( #{branchid}, #{memberid}, hex(aes_encrypt(#{memberpw},'ttokssaem_2022@')), #{type}, #{membername}, #{schoolcode}, #{schoolname}, #{grade}, #{gender}, #{contact}, #{email}, #{marketing}, #{push}, now() )
mapper.update:
UPDATE ttok.member
membername = #{membername},
memberpw = hex(aes_encrypt(#{memberpw},'ttokssaem_2022@')),
type = #{type},
schoolcode = #{schoolcode},
schoolname = #{schoolname},
grade = #{grade},
gender = #{gender},
contact = #{contact},
email = #{email},
marketing = #{marketing},
push = #{push},
AND branchid = #{branchid} AND memberid = #{memberid}
